No boundary receipt covers src/rand/rand_lib.rs (RAND_poll).

mechanisms.next_action: Contract RAND_poll (src/rand/rand_lib.rs:582) as a consumer-reachable boundary (seed/poll result, no owned block), the smallest uncovered redis symbol in this mechanism.

verdict.reason: 1 of 7 measured mechanisms is SAFETY_DISCHARGED (ERR, mechanism scope). The remaining 6 are 4x OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED/CONTRACTED (RAND_CMS_STORE_KEYFMT, EVP_PKEY_PROVIDER, RUNTIME_CONCURRENCY, SSL_SESSION) and 2x UNSAFE_OPEN (BIO, RUNTIME_ALLOC_OWNERSHIP). AGENTS.md section 7 requires every applicable mechanism SAFETY_DISCHARGED. L7 functional DROP_IN_PASS is necessary but not sufficient.

blockers.detail: ERR mechanism scope is discharged; the redis consumer mapping (ERR_peek_last_error, ERR_reason_error_string) is RE_ADJUDICATION_PENDING.
X509_VERIFY_POLICY is not in the measured 7 but redis imports four verify-path symbols; conservative reading adds it unless non-impact is proven.
No independent phase17-style redis harness; blocks independent compatibility confirmation, not safety discharge.

closure_expansion_candidates.rule: Conservative reading, matching C2: an imported symbol that enters an x509/pem/evp/BIO entry point pulls that mechanism into the closure unless non-impact is proven. This is inference, not a measured call graph.

schema_mismatch.requested_vs_c2: The task requested keys family/candidate/generated/mechanisms[id,status,evidence,blocker,next_action]/discharged_count/total_count/graduation. C2 uses schema/subphase/date_utc/candidate_identity/closure[].safety_state/verdict/counts. C3 keeps the task keys and adds C2-compatible schema, source_identity, ledger_record, symbol_evidence, safety_state, discharged, verdict, closure_expansion_candidates. The requested 5-value status is a coarse projection of the campaign's 3-value safety_state vocabulary; safety_state is retained verbatim.

status_projection.INDEPENDENTLY_CHECKED: independent review exists but no discharge (none among the 7 after B37)
